svg.text: Guardrail 01 · Hop 1 In-Memory JWKS & JTI Denylist (< 0.15 ms)
• 60-minute async background JWKS refresh eliminates synchronous IdP calls on the hot path.
• Valkey JTI denylist check completes in 0.4 ms p99 (7.5% of the 2.0 ms Hop 1 SLA budget).
Guardrail 02 · PgBouncer Transaction Reset & 32k Prefix Order
• Transaction pooler enforces DISCARD ALL on release + SET LOCAL app.current_tenant_id.
• 89.1% net token savings (32,768 / 36,468 static prefix) with 0 customer bytes in shared cache.
Guardrail 03 · Singleflight Stampede Lock & Scoped UNLINK (< 5.0 s)
• SET lock:{tenant}:schema NX PX 5000 prevents cold-start thundering herds on schema refresh.
• Scoped SCAN 0 MATCH {tenant}:* -> UNLINK evicts 1 tenant in <5s while keeping siblings at 100%.
Triggers Pattern A → C / B split
DETERMINISTIC WIRE & KERNEL INVARIANTS ENFORCED IN CI/CD BEFORE EVERY DEPLOYMENT
SET LOCAL app.current_tenant_id = $jwt_tid | PgBouncer DISCARD ALL | SCAN 0 MATCH {tenant}:* UNLINK | kms.encrypt(ping) <= 60s
